meta.description: Cambridge movers for students, recent grads and apartment renters: small loads, summer storage and September 1 moves, billed by the hour. Free quote.

overview: A lot of Cambridge moves are a room's worth of things, a bike and a deadline set by a lease or a semester. Better Life Moving sizes the job to that, with a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.
Need the summer in between? We'll hold your things and bring them back in the fall.
sellingPoints: Small loads billed like small loads

servicesBlock.h2: What Cambridge Renters and Students Book Most
servicesBlock.intro: For students and recent grads, college moves, furniture-only jobs and storage are usually the best fit. The full list is below, and any of it can go on one quote.

whyChoose.h2: Why Cambridge Movers Should Be Booked Early

cards.title: September Fills Up Fast
cards.text: Semesters and leases both turn over around September 1, and those weeks are our busiest. Book as soon as the date is set.

cards.title: A Minimum That Suits a Dorm Room
cards.text: Small jobs fall under our 2-hour minimum that includes travel time, so moving one room doesn't cost like moving a house.

cards.title: Storage From the Movers Themselves
cards.text: We pick up in spring and redeliver in fall. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

cards.title: Parents Can Book for Students
cards.text: Anyone can request the quote. Give us the student's addresses and a number to reach on the day.

faq.q: How are Cambridge movers billed for a small student move?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. A dorm room or a studio often lands near that minimum.

faq.q: Can you store a student's things in Cambridge over the summer?
faq.a: Yes. We collect at move-out, keep everything in storage and deliver to the fall address on the date you give us.

faq.q: Do you follow building move-in and move-out times in Cambridge?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the loading hours and any building rules when you book, and the crew schedules the move inside them.

faq.q: Can you pick up furniture from a roommate across town?
faq.a: Yes. A bed frame or a couch from one Cambridge apartment to another is a normal furniture-only job for us.

faq.q: I'm graduating and leaving Massachusetts. Can you move me?
faq.a: Yes. A move out of state is a long distance move, quoted at a flat rate and carried on our own truck from Cambridge to your new home.

faqClosing: Still deciding? The FAQ page has more on how booking and moving day work.

closing.h2: Lock In Your Cambridge Moving Date
closing.body: Send the move-out date, both addresses and whether storage is part of it. We'll tell you how the bill is worked out before you commit.
